class.name: HEGoGeoSurfaces
class.brief_description: A cooked node's surfaces, read and split from code.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Whether the cook produced a mesh part with faces.

method.name: get_primitive_count
method.description: Number of primitives in the output.

method.name: get_attribute_names
method.description: Names of every primitive attribute, as Houdini reports them. Available without loading anything.

method.name: get_attribute_names_with_prefix
method.description: The primitive attribute names starting with [code]prefix[/code], for handling whatever an HDA chose to add without naming each one in advance.

method.name: has_attribute
method.description: Whether a primitive attribute of that name exists.

method.name: load_attributes
method.description: Reads primitive attributes so filtering, splitting and [method HEGoGeoPrimSelection.get_surface] can use them. The only call here that talks to the session.

method.name: get_attribute
method.description: The values of a loaded primitive attribute, one per primitive. Empty, with a warning, for an attribute that exists but was never loaded.

method.name: select_all
method.description: Every primitive, as a selection to filter and split further.

method.name: split_by
method.description: The primitives grouped by the value of [code]name[/code], as [code]{ value: HEGoGeoPrimSelection }[/code].
